confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge only; no live menus, listings or rate pages were inspected. Meals, coffee and budget accommodation are moderate confidence. Cocktail and wine are lower confidence and were set from the beer price (cocktail about 2.5x and wine about 2.3x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. The 3-star hotel anchor is also less certain given tax and seasonal variation; July is a quieter monsoon period on the west coast. FX taken from search-result summaries attributed to the rba.gov.au overview page; that page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; South Asian regional basis judged from general knowledge of tourist price levels in other South and Southeast Asian capitals, with service charges, taxes and high alcohol excise reflected by judgement.
